title: Where Champions Actually Came From

meta_description: None of the eight College Football Playoff champions from 2018 through 2025 were week-1 AP No. 1. Five came from 2-4. Indiana won in 2025 from week-1 rank 20.
excerpt: From 2018 through 2025, 0 of 8 CFP champions opened at week-1 AP No. 1. Five came from ranks 2-4, two from 5-10, and Indiana won in 2025 from 20.
